SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, ENTRUST_ID id FROM ETR_ENTRUST
AND ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_STATUS IN(#{entrustAwait},#{entrustDistribute},#{entrustReceive},#{entrustUntread},#{entrustClose},#{entrustReturn},#{entrustRecall})
AND ENTRUST_ID like concat(concat('%',#{etrId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_ABBR text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_9, T2.TYPE_10, T2.TYPE_11, to_char(T1.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') MDATE, T1.CCY FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID

SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text, B.IS_GUARANTEE object, A.PROFIT_TYPE col FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
(A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

SELECT distinct SYS_USER.USER_NAME id, SYS_USER.REAL_NAME text ,SYS_USER.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM SYS_USER INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE ON SYS_USER.USER_NAME = SYS_USER_ROLE.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.ROLE_ID = SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID
AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_POS IN( #{roleOne}, #{roleTwo} )
AND (SYS_USER.USER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR SYS_USER.REAL_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
